premises: A quantity of a hundred-thousand is situated in the mass of forehead syllables.
The act has been completed prior to the offering in question.
The recipient is one who is worshipped by the gods.
inference: The completed offering of that quantity is directed specifically to the god-worshipped recipient.
uncertainties: The exact ritual scope of the offering remains unclear from this verse alone.
